title: Build the proving ground
outcome: Turn the research into a public operating system for missions, maintainers, and design partners.
deliverables: Launch ranked catalog and mission pages
Recruit the first builders and adopters
successMetric: 10 qualified builder submissions and one committed design partner

title: Canny → Fider proving mission
outcome: Prove that SaaSassin creates more value by strengthening a credible project than by starting another repository.
deliverables: Ship Canny import and migration guide
Add roadmap, changelog, and SSO improvements
successMetric: Three real migrations and one paying hosted customer

title: Motion → Open Planner
outcome: Show that a small AI-native team can ship a trusted planning loop without a proprietary model moat.
deliverables: Add explainable rescheduling and BYO AI
successMetric: 20 weekly active users and four-week retention above 40%

title: Dovetail → Open Research Repository
outcome: Deliver the first flagship replacement around sensitive data ownership and durable organizational memory.
deliverables: Ship tags, clips, and semantic search
successMetric: Two organizations migrate a live research archive
